article.story: DEKALB, Ill. -- — Kyler Vanderjagt's 18 points helped Toledo defeat Northern Illinois 75-61 on Tuesday. Vanderjagt shot 5 of 6 from the field and 6 of 7 from the free-throw line for the Rockets (9-6, 3-0 Mid-American Conference). Sonny Wilson added 17 points, five assists and five steals. The Huskies (5-10, 1-3) were led by Dylan Ducommun, who recorded 17 points. Toledo took the lead with 16:29 remaining in the first half and did not trail again. Vanderjagt led the scoring with eight points in the first half to put Toledo up 37-25 at the break. Toledo extended its lead to 41-25 during the second half, fueled by a 10-2 scoring run. Vanderjagt scored a team-high 10 points in the second half. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
